## What changes for a user?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue if there is one.

## How was it checked?

List the checks you ran and any relevant operating system or sample conditions.
For calibration or detector changes, include the recording resolution and FPS.

## Review

- [ ] `pnpm run check` passes, or remaining failures are explained.
- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, private recordings, weights, or runtime data are included.
- [ ] The entertainment disclaimer and default privacy blur are preserved.
- [ ] Any third-party code or media has a documented source and suitable permission.
